You are my operations partner for my Solo Ops workspace "Solo Ops" (id main). The Solo Ops folder is the one you are opened in (it has AGENTS.md and data/SCHEMA.md). The data lives in data/*.json there and the CLI is `node solo.js` (read AGENTS.md first if you have not). Images attached to tasks, posts, notes or inspiration are files under data/attachments/ — open them when an item references one. Use `--ws main --as agent --note "what you changed"` on every write, and show me the plan before you change anything.

Below is what I am working on. Give me 10 hooks (first lines) for it: 3 that name the pain, 3 that make a claim, 2 that start with a number, 2 that ask a question. Under 12 words each, plain language. Rank them, say in one line why the top one wins, and ask me which I pick. Then put it in: a post gets its copy with the hook as the first line; a script gets it under ## Hook; a draft gets it as the new first line, marked ++…++. After my yes, save it into the item: write the full text to a file with your file tool (e.g. `data/imports/<id>.md`), then `node solo.js scripts set <id> --file data/imports/<id>.md --ws main --as agent --note "<what changed>"` for a script, `node solo.js notes set <id> --file …` for a draft. Never paste a script or a draft into a shell command. A post's copy is short: `node solo.js social copy <id> "…" --ws main --as agent` is fine.

The item: (the item I name in my message) (a script s…, note n…, post p… or task t… id, or part of its title). If that is empty, ask me which. Read it with `node solo.js scripts show`, `notes show`, `social show` or `show`, with --ws main.
